items.name: unsalted butter
items.note: melted, plus more for the pan

segs.v: Pour the wet ingredients into the dry and fold just until no dry flour remains. Lumps are good. Rest
Heat a buttered griddle over medium heat. Pour scant ⅓-cup portions. Cook until bubbles cover the surface,
Keep warm in a 200°F oven while you cook the rest. Makes about 3 pancakes.
